name: @pipeworx/mcp-auto-dev

tools.name: autodev_vin_decode
tools.description: Decode a VIN into a full vehicle spec (year, make, model, trim, engine, body, drivetrain, fuel type). Example: autodev_vin_decode({ vin: "1FTFW3LDXRFB40317", _apiKey: "your-key" })

_apiKey.description: Auto.dev API key (1,000 free calls/mo at auto.dev)

tools.name: autodev_listings
tools.description: Find used cars for sale matching criteria (make/model/price/location) — active listings from US physical & online dealers. Example: autodev_listings({ make: "Toyota", model: "Camry", year_min: 2020, price_max: 30000, zip: "94103", limit: 20, _apiKey: "your-key" })

zip.description: ZIP code to center the search on (optional)

radius.description: Search radius in miles from zip (optional)

_apiKey.description: Auto.dev API key (1,000 free calls/mo at auto.dev)

tools.name: autodev_valuation
tools.description: Estimated value for a vehicle — market price and total cost of ownership (depreciation, insurance, maintenance, fuel) for a VIN. Example: autodev_valuation({ vin: "1FTFW3LDXRFB40317", zip: "94103", _apiKey: "your-key" })

zip.description: ZIP code for location-specific cost estimates (optional)

_apiKey.description: Auto.dev API key (1,000 free calls/mo at auto.dev)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-auto-dev forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the auto-dev pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
